announcement.quote: Golub Capital BDC, Inc. Announces Merger Agreement With Golub Capital Investment Corporation

outcome_evidence.quote: has completed its previously announced merger with Golub Capital Investment Corporation (“GCIC”), with GBDC as the surviving company.

deals.notes: GBDC is shown as NASDAQ-listed, but the excerpts never state whether GCIC (a BDC, Commission File No. 814-01128) is exchange-listed, so both_listed is null. GBDC stockholder approval announced 2019-09-04 (0001476765-19-000083).
